items.t: Fuel pump relay and rear fuse block melt
items.job: Replace fuel pump relay and rear fuse block
items.note: Owners report about $240–$340 for a fuse block and up to about $780 at a dealer for relay and fuse block. A damaged fuel pump adds cost.

items.t: Fuel pump fails and engine stalls
items.job: Replace in-tank fuel pump module
items.note: Check the relay and rear fuse block first; they are a common cause.

items.t: Ignition key can slip out of Run (recall)
items.job: Install new key ring and key insert (recall 14V-355)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN.

items.t: Heated washer fluid system can overheat and catch fire (recall)
items.job: Disable or repair heated washer module (recalls 08V-441 and 10V-240)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN.

items.t: Power steering hose can fail and leak (recall)
items.job: Replace power steering hose (recall 06V-105)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN.

items.t: Battery cable can rub a power steering line (recall)
items.job: Reroute battery cable and repair power steering line (recall 10V-553)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN.

items.t: Automatic transmission slips or fails
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with a remanufactured unit
items.note: CarComplaints owners report average costs of about $1,800–$3,300.

items.t: Head gasket failure and overheating
items.job: Replace Northstar head gaskets with head bolt thread repair
items.note: The engine usually has to come out. CarComplaints owners report about $5,000 for overheating repairs; a used engine may cost less.

items.t: Engine stalls from a failing crankshaft sensor or ignition module
items.job: Replace crankshaft position sensor or ignition control module
items.note: One owner paid $939 for an ignition control module repair.

items.t: Oil leaks and burning oil smell
items.job: Find and reseal oil leak (valve cover or oil pan gasket)
items.note: RepairPal lists oil pan replacement at about $700–$886. Northstar lower seal leaks can cost much more.

items.t: Shocks and struts leak or fail
items.job: Replace front struts or rear shocks (pair)
items.note: Magnetic ride control shocks on CXS and Super models cost much more than standard ones. Owners report about $1,800.

items.t: Clunk in the steering when turning slowly
items.job: Replace intermediate steering shaft

items.t: Power steering fluid leaks
items.job: Replace leaking power steering line or reservoir

items.t: ABS, traction and StabiliTrak lights come on
items.job: Replace wheel speed sensor or front hub

items.t: No crank, no start with the security light on
items.job: Diagnose no-crank and repair per GM bulletin
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $700 on average.

items.t: No crank and dark gear display from damaged wiring
items.job: Repair transmission wiring harness

items.t: Reduced power and check engine light from the throttle body
items.job: Clean or replace electronic throttle body

items.t: Intermittent check engine light and reduced power from a dash wiring connector
items.job: Repair instrument panel to body harness connector

items.t: Knock sensor codes and spark knock
items.job: Replace knock sensor
items.note: On the 3.8L V6 the knock sensors are low on the engine block.

items.t: Engine mounts break
items.job: Replace engine mount or torque strut
items.note: RepairPal lists engine mount replacement at about $419–$463.

items.t: Front wheel bearing hum
items.job: Replace front hub and bearing assembly (one side)

items.t: Corroded wheel rims leak air
items.job: Clean and reseal tire bead on wheel
items.note: Per wheel. Refinishing or replacing a badly corroded wheel costs more.
